homograph.note: Verb /ˈɪmplɪment/ 'carry out a plan' and noun /ˈɪmplɪmənt/ 'a tool' differ in the final vowel and in part of speech, and a learner who knows one will not guess the other. A hint must say which sense it targets; the exam tested the verb.

senses.definition: to put a plan, decision or system into effect so that it actually happens

examples.en: The ministry will implement the new rules at the start of next year.
examples.fa: وزارتخانه قوانین جدید را از ابتدای سال آینده اجرا خواهد کرد.

senses.definition: a tool or simple piece of equipment used for a particular job, especially outdoor work

examples.en: The shed was full of rusting farm implements.
examples.fa: انباری پر بود از ابزارهای زنگ‌زده‌ی کشاورزی.
